core_idea: T Corp. Class 2 Collection Staff Rodion is a Damage Dealer / Support — **Tremor** control — stack for early stagger breaks. Scaling conditions: Clash Power +1 per 6 Tremor (max +2). Support passive (**T Corp. Martial Arts**) buffs your **fastest Speed ally** — pair with a high-Speed attacker.
playstyle_guide:
- **T Corp. Martial Arts** amplifies the **fastest Speed ally** — field a high-Speed damage dealer as teammate.
- **Time Moratorium** — time the stored-damage pop with your Tremor stacks.
- **Counter: Borrow Time** grants 3 **Borrowed Time at Turn End** automatically at Combat Start — you already have it on turn one; no defense turn required.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Clash Power +1 per 6 Tremor (max +2).

**S1 — Prepare to Collect** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- **Clash Power** scales with **Tremor** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Gain +2 Tremor Count; [On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 6 Tremor on target (max 2)
- Gain +1 Tremor Count; [Hit after Clash Win] Inflict +1 Tremor Count

**S2 — T Corp. Martial Suppression** (BP 4, CP +5, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 14 (Slightly Low).
- Deal +5% damage for every Bind on target (max 15%) ; [On Use] Gain +2 Tremor Count ; [On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 6 Tremor on target (max 2)
- **Clash Power** scales with **Tremor** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Deal +5% damage for every Bind on target (max 15%); [On Use] Gain +2 Tremor Count; [On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 6 Tremor on target (max 2)
- Gain +2 Tremor Count; [Hit after Clash Win] Inflict +2 Tremor Count
- Peak output requires both conditions: Inflict 1 Bind next turn | [On Hit] If target has 6+ Tremor, inflict 1 Bind next turn.

**S3 — Execute Collections** (BP 2, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 2, high 14 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Deal +5% damage for every Bind on target (max 20%) | [On Use] If target has 8+ Tremor, Clash Power +2.

Combat passive — **Golden Time - Standoff**: Turn End: If this unit's HP is between 16% ~ 20%, instantly heal up to 60% of Max HP, and recover from Stagger. (once per Encounter).
  - When Clashing against targets that have Time Moratorium, Clash Power +2.
  - Take -10% damage from targets that have Time Moratorium.

Defense skill — **Counter: Borrow Time**: [Combat Start] If this unit is not in a Borrowed Time state, gain 3 Borrowed Time at Turn End (once per turn).
  - [On Use] For this turn: when hit by an enemy, inflict 2 Tremor on target next turn (6 times per turn).
